  AND bl.billTimestamp::date >= '2026-06-01'

sql_calls.sql:
SELECT SUM(l.qty) AS total_bags_sold
FROM store.pos_lines l
JOIN store.products p ON l.sku_scanned = p.sku
WHERE p.pack = '5 kg'
  AND p.name ILIKE '%atta%'
  AND l.bill_ts::date >= '2026-06-01'
  AND l.bill_ts::date < '2026-07-01';

SELECT DISTINCT a.auditTimestamp::date AS audit_date
FROM store.shelf_audit a
JOIN store.products p ON a.ofProduct = p.sku
WHERE p.pack = '5 kg'
  AND p.name ILIKE '%atta%'
  AND a.auditTimestamp::date BETWEEN '2026-06-01' AND '2026-06-30';

sql_calls.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS on_shelf_records
FROM store.shelf_audits a
JOIN store.products p ON a.sku = p.sku
WHERE p.pack = '5 kg'
  AND p.name ILIKE '%atta%'
  AND a.audit_ts::date >= '2026-06-01'
  AND a.audit_ts::date < '2026-07-01'
  AND a.status = 'on shelf';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.audit_ts::date) AS on_shelf_days
FROM store.shelf_audits a
JOIN store.products p ON a.sku = p.sku
WHERE p.pack = '5 kg'
  AND p.name ILIKE '%atta%'
  AND a.audit_ts::date BETWEEN '2026-06-01' AND '2026-06-30'
  AND a.status = 'on shelf';
